[[Frost Invasion Event|Frost Invasion]] |previous_pass = N/A |next_pass = [[Frost Invasion Event#Frost Invasion Season|Frost Invasion]] }} ==Description== The '''Halloween 2020 Event''' was the sixth event to be added to Tower Defense Simulator. It released as two individual parts, with the first part being released on the 31st of October 2020 and the second part being released on the 23rd of November 2020. Triumphing the event would give you the [[Badges|Halloween 2020 Badge]] which would give the [[Toxic Gunner]], though this was added only after the event ended. This event included numerous exclusive enemies (some of which were remade from the previous year's [[Halloween 2019 Event|Halloween event]]), new skins and three new emotes. For a limited time, the [[Slasher]] gamepass returned for {{Robux|400}}, and went offsale on the 6th of November, along with the [[Archer]] gamepass. ==Halloween Season Pass== [[File:BattlePass.png|center|500px|thumb]] You earned candies by playing [[Trick or Threat Town]]. If you ranked up, your candies earned in the same match did not carry over to the next rank. The amount of Candies for each wave is as follows: ::100 Candies × (Waves/18)^1.75 + 50 Candies (Triumph Only) In total, it would take 6,185 Candies, or {{Robux|1,950}} to complete the '''Halloween To be exact, it was available to play for 189 days. *This event's lobby theme, ''Spooky!'', became notorious in the Tower Defense Simulator community as it played continuously for the entire duration of the event. **Because of this infamy, it would often return in later Halloween updates. In the [[v1.4.2|Halloween 2022]], there was a rare chance it could play in the lobby, while in the [[v1.9.0|Lunar Overture Update]], the {{Color|Lunar|Masquerade}} [[DJ Booth]] skin was added, which played this theme. ==Notes== {{EventNavBox}} [[Category:Passes]]
